_about: Trusted Israeli vendors to search directly, per product category, in waves. Wave 1 is always searched for the category; wave 2 when wave 1 misses, is thin, or the user wants breadth. Search URL patterns use {q} for the URL-encoded query (Hebrew category noun + Latin brand/model). 'route' is the backend that was verified to work: curl = plain GET with a desktop Chrome UA from an Israeli IP; script = a bundled script; browser = real browser only (bot wall). Users add or override vendors in <plugin-data-dir>/trusted-vendors.json (same shape; entries with the same 'id' replace these). The full roster of ~800+ Israeli stores with Zap categories is the Israel-Online-Stores dataset (see docs/search-strategies.md).

ksp.name: KSP
ksp.how: python3 skills/ksp-branch-stock/scripts/ksp_stock.py "<query>" --all  (JSON API with Sec-Fetch-* + Referer headers; the HTML site returns 403 to every automated route)
ksp.notes: Quote the regular price, not the Eilat price.

ivory.name: Ivory
ivory.how: python3 skills/ivory-branch-stock/scripts/ivory_stock.py "<query>" --all, or curl the search URL
ivory.notes: Price appears as 'מחיר רגיל: N' in each catalogVertical_item card.

bug.name: Bug
bug.notes: Large page (~1.3 MB); grep the model string rather than reading it whole.

plonter.name: Plonter
plonter.notes: Incapsula bot wall blocks curl, the agent browser and Claude in Chrome alike (2026-11-20); the search URL is from indexed pages, not live-verified. Try it in a browser the user has already used on the site; otherwise fall back to web search site:plonter.co.il and Zap (Plonter lists on Zap).

kzpro.name: KZPro
kzpro.notes: Pro audio, microphones, studio. Same platform as Kley Zemer (same group). Plain keyword match: use short queries (brand or model alone, no Hebrew noun). Price in span.saleprice inside div.item_details. 'לא נמצאו תוצאות' = no hit.

speedofsound.name: Speed of Sound
speedofsound.notes: Headphones, microphones, audio. Example: /product/shure-sm7b. Brand pages: /brand/<brand>.
speedofsound.how: No results page (search is a JS dropdown). Find the product in https://www.speedofsound.co.il/sitemap.xml (~700 /product/<slug> and /brand/<slug> URLs), then curl the product page; price is in the page JSON ("price":N).

halilit.name: Halilit (חלילית)
halilit.notes: Musical instruments, studio and PA. Official importer for many brands.

kleyzemer.name: Kley Zemer (כלי זמר)
kleyzemer.notes: Musical instruments and pro audio chain; same platform as KZPro. Short queries. span.saleprice is sometimes empty in served HTML: confirm the price on the product page or in a browser.

computer_parts.label: Computer parts and components (SSD, RAM, GPU, CPU, PSU, cases, motherboards)

consumer_tech.label: Consumer tech (laptops, phones, peripherals, monitors, TVs, chargers, cables)

microphones_audio.label: Microphones, headphones, audio interfaces, studio monitors, pro audio
